name: preview-compose
description: Runs Jetpack Compose @Preview functions from the terminal without opening Android Studio. Two paths: headless PNG via Paparazzi and interactive on-device render via a debug-only PreviewActivity. Auto-offers on @Preview edits and runs when the user says 'preview', 'show me', 'render this', or 'on the emulator'. Requires scripts/preview-compose.sh in the target project.
